surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 59 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Ad-Dukhaan (The Smoke) is the 44th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 59 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: حمٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ حم
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم حم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Ha, Meem
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Ha Mim

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والكتاب المبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the clear Book
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the Scripture that makes things clear

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا انزلناه في ليلة مباركة ۚ انا كنا منذرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فيها يفرق كل امر حكيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: On that night is made distinct every precise matter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْرًا مِنْ عِنْدِنَا ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: امرا من عندنا ۚ انا كنا مرسلين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: رحمة من ربك ۚ انه هو السميع العليم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: رب السماوات والارض وما بينهما ۖ ان كنتم موقنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا اله الا هو يحيي ويميت ۖ ربكم ورب ابائكم الاولين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بل هم في شك يلعبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فارتقب يوم تاتي السماء بدخان مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَغْشَى النَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يغشى الناس ۖ هذا عذاب اليم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Covering the people; this is a painful torment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ربنا اكشف عنا العذاب انا مؤمنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انى لهم الذكرى وقد جاءهم رسول مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمࣱ مَّجۡنُونٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم تولوا عنه وقالوا معلم مجنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا كاشفو العذاب قليلا ۚ انكم عائدون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم نبطش البطشة الكبرى انا منتقمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ ولقد فتنا قبلهم قوم فرعون وجاءهم رسول كريم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَنْ أَدُّوا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان ادوا الي عباد الله ۖ اني لكم رسول امين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَنْ لَا تَعْلُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي آتِيكُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان لا تعلوا على الله ۖ اني اتيكم بسلطان مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَنْ تَرْجُمُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واني عذت بربي وربكم ان ترجمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان لم تؤمنوا لي فاعتزلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فدعا ربه ان هؤلاء قوم مجرمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاسر بعبادي ليلا انكم متبعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واترك البحر رهوا ۖ انهم جند مغرقون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَمْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كم تركوا من جنات وعيون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Many a garden and spring they left behind

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَزُرُوعࣲ وَمَقَامࣲ كَرِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وزروع ومقام كريم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And crops and noble sites
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: many a cornfield and noble building

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَعۡمَةࣲ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونعمة كانوا فيها فاكهين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And comfort wherein they were amused
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: many a thing in which they had delighted

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذلك ۖ واورثناها قوما اخرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We gave these to another people to inherit

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنْظَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فما بكت عليهم السماء والارض وما كانوا منظرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد نجينا بني اسرائيل من العذاب المهين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: من فرعون ۚ انه كان عاليا من المسرفين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد اخترناهم على علم على العالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We chose them knowingly above others

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤࣱ اْ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَاءٌ مُبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واتيناهم من الايات ما فيه بلاء مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان هؤلاء ليقولون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: These people here assert

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان هي الا موتتنا الاولى وما نحن بمنشرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاتوا بابائنا ان كنتم صادقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اهم خير ام قوم تبع والذين من قبلهم ۚ اهلكناهم ۖ انهم كانوا مجرمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Are they better than the people of Tubbaand those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما خلقنا السماوات والارض وما بينهما لاعبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما خلقناهما الا بالحق ولكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان يوم الفصل ميقاتهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلࣰ ى شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم لا يغني مولى عن مولى شيئا ولا هم ينصرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a Day when no friend can take another’s place

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا من رحم الله ۚ انه هو العزيز الرحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان شجرت الزقوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The tree of Zaqqum

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: طعام الاثيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is food for the sinful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: will be food for the sinners

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كالمهل يغلي في البطون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كغلي الحميم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Like the boiling of scalding water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: like seething water

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: خذوه فاعتلوه الى سواء الجحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم صبوا فوق راسه من عذاب الحميم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ذق انك انت العزيز الكريم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان هذا ما كنتم به تمترون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is what you doubted.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان المتقين في مقام امين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: في جنات وعيون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Within gardens and springs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: amid Gardens and springs

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسࣲ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَلْبَسُونَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يلبسون من سندس واستبرق متقابلين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذلك وزوجناهم بحور عين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ آمِنِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يدعون فيها بكل فاكهة امنين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا يذوقون فيها الموت الا الموتة الاولى ۖ ووقاهم عذاب الجحيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فضلا من ربك ۚ ذلك هو الفوز العظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فانما يسرناه بلسانك لعلهم يتذكرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُمْ مُرْتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فارتقب انهم مرتقبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting
